selection_method: Main-agent editorial comparison of all 150 compact property/prediction projections, followed by full-field reading of the 25 emphasized constructions. Emphasis is causal interaction, matched-world separation, breadth and generative upside. No novelty scores, aggregate ranking or additional court informed this selection. All 150 compounds and all 120 earlier sharpened candidates remain available.

compounds.reason: A service improvement changes the independent evidence required to reclaim human support, not just the amount of support.
compounds.editorial_caution: Define typed unmet needs and independently verified ground truth; supported competence is real and reduced surveillance can be a benefit.

compounds.reason: External canon investment and sincere self-reasons reinforce one another; felt authorship and the cost of future departure may rise together.
compounds.editorial_caution: A creator may value stable tradition. The outcome is a requested departure cost, not a universal authenticity loss.

compounds.reason: Fresh testimony and intervention-produced opportunities can jointly regenerate a deleted category without any retained old profile.
compounds.editorial_caution: Regenerated evidence may be accurate. Test history dependence and option formation without treating all preference development as manipulation.

compounds.reason: Trials and comparative calibration share a finite budget, so the evaluation process helps produce the next comparison.
compounds.editorial_caution: Precision does not by itself raise quality. Specify a risk-sensitive evaluator; worse knowledge is relative to a same-budget comparator unless drift or finite windows are modeled.

compounds.reason: Translation can preserve daily language use while teaching the codification that later validates its own claim to fidelity.
compounds.editorial_caution: Historical preservation and legitimately chosen cultural change are different claims; do not presume a static authentic tradition.

compounds.reason: Market selection and prerequisite learning can remove the production path for the next expert cohort before current expertise falls.
compounds.editorial_caution: Apprenticeship erosion is inherited. The proposed addition must survive comparison with models already containing organizational selection and prerequisites.

compounds.reason: An adapter can remove the claimant standing through which its own semantic non-equivalence would be detected.
compounds.editorial_caution: A lawful collective process can authorize changes of standing. Action completion alone is an insufficient test, not proof of illegitimacy.

compounds.reason: Closure success, review funding and appeal prerequisites can make observed reliability partly a product of reduced independent challenge production.
compounds.editorial_caution: Routine reliability can genuinely improve justice. Test warranted rare challenges and resource costs rather than maximizing dissent.

compounds.reason: Modification-shaped current testimony and economical lineage grouping jointly obscure the temporal claims that grouping is meant to represent.
compounds.editorial_caution: Artificial moral standing is unresolved. Current testimony can remain sincere and a newly chosen identity can deserve protection.

compounds.reason: Successful action memory, negative constraints and running alternative procedures jointly determine what remains causally distinguishable after a shift.
compounds.editorial_caution: Generic nonidentification is not a new theorem. Full ordinary rationale archives or independent probes can erase the proposed gap.

compounds.reason: A beneficial reverse loop: substantive handover disagreement can produce constraints that improve later switching, even after a difficult first transfer.
compounds.editorial_caution: The user must actually learn reusable constraints. Cosmetic disagreements and exhausting repeated reconstruction need not help.

compounds.reason: Pooled certificate fees fund recognition of an essential bundle, coupling voluntary affordability choices to infrastructural gate formation.
compounds.editorial_caution: Discounts can expand access. Distinguish certifier, provider, counterparty and public recognition; fees are not automatically taxes.

compounds.reason: Predictive care scheduling removes alternative witnesses, making later privacy exercise and retrospective redress collide.
compounds.editorial_caution: Equal visit hours do not establish equal observation coverage; independent selective evidence can protect both privacy and appeal.

compounds.reason: Recognizing a collective veto can concentrate its enabling routes and resources, so stronger legal voice need not mean a more feasible joint refusal.
compounds.editorial_caution: Standing and resource appropriation are separate institutional interventions. Concentration may also efficiently pool fallback.

compounds.reason: Maintenance selection changes embodied etiquette, then changes the public activity counted in planning evidence for that etiquette.
compounds.editorial_caution: Local interpretation and planning rules must be specified. No universal cultural response to robot gestures is assumed.

compounds.reason: An administrative representation unit can select the histories later used as evidence that the unit is adequate.
compounds.editorial_caution: Do not mistake excluded putative claims for established welfare interests. Independent sampling may support the original unit.

compounds.reason: Provider entry, certificate revenue and recognition investment form a return path in which competition may strengthen the gate enabling entry.
compounds.editorial_caution: Static fragmentation is already inherited. The additional financing/entry feedback must change a prediction; public proof paths or plural guarantors can reverse it.

compounds.reason: A positive societal loop: human transition support can produce public skills and mutual aid that reduce burden in later transitions.
compounds.editorial_caution: Voluntary, replenishable participation is essential. Do not disguise unpaid family obligation as a commons.

compounds.reason: Rare veto use changes reserve funding and interpretive reproduction, which changes the feasibility of the vetoes that remain formally intact.
compounds.editorial_caution: Fixed shortage alone is ordinary congestion. The consequential object is adoption-attributable change in joint refusal capacity.

compounds.reason: Immediate local stopping can synchronize residual-settlement demand and lengthen recognized release through persistent counterparty reliance.
compounds.editorial_caution: This requires real residual obligations and finite shared disposition capacity. Faster stopping itself remains an important safety benefit.

compounds.reason: Bilateral adapter usability and local review adequacy can jointly fail to create any valid end-to-end workflow.
compounds.editorial_caution: An extra adapter is not guaranteed to help. Binding snapshots and coordinated renewals can remove the obstruction.

compounds.reason: Truthful uncertainty disclosure can attract user experiments while concentrating provider-private response knowledge and leaving alternatives undermeasured.
compounds.editorial_caution: Use relative comparative coverage, not a claim that truthful evidence destroys knowledge. Public experimental receipts can make the loop beneficial.

compounds.reason: Teachable maintenance can sustain embodied cultural interpretation and independent human support through reciprocal practice.
compounds.editorial_caution: Unteachable or coerced maintenance can produce only burdens. Lower maintenance cost can be genuinely preferable.

compounds.reason: Repeated technical refusal can acquire normative meaning through an audience that changes default practice, reproducing the refusal pattern.
compounds.editorial_caution: This is highly culturally contingent. No religious tradition is assumed to treat a robot as a doctrinal authority.

compounds.reason: Institutional recognition and physical planning can amplify the effects of a fixed local proposal interface without enlarging its formal tool set.
compounds.editorial_caution: A sound effect abstraction may already cover downstream execution. The case concerns changing institutional response, not a counterexample to every scope ceiling.

paradoxes.reason: Assisted success changes whether future need can be proven.
Oversight headcount and articulation-cut resilience separate.
Fresh independent intake can regenerate an erased interpretation.
Better local precision can crowd out comparative measurement.
Local authorization and prospective rule adoption have different contents.
Completed-action memory and operative negative constraints separate.
Sincerity now does not identify every earlier branch's claim.
Competition can intensify a recognition bottleneck under specific adapter and funding conditions.
Locally sufficient review need not yield a jointly valid object.
Insurance expands financially credible claims without necessarily producing deliverable expertise.
Counted participation can consume the intervals needed to form a view.
Courtesy credits can finance a durable claim on public space.
Administrative consistency can select away the histories needed to test representation.
A beneficial reversal: transition support can reproduce independent public capability.
Increasing authentic grants can shrink the future joint veto frontier through reserve production.
Faster origin correction can overload recursive descendant remedies.
Local stop latency and aggregate recognized-release latency can move oppositely.
Recoverable machine state can coexist with lost human witness evidence.
Present appeal access and the production of future reviewers can conflict.
Smaller individual scopes can increase required occupational chains.

foundational_upside.reason: The category can persist as a distributed production process rather than a stored object.
foundational_upside.main_uncertainty: May already be fully explained by labeling, developmental opportunity and self-concept models.

foundational_upside.reason: A profession's current competence and its capacity to reproduce competence become different social states.
foundational_upside.main_uncertainty: The exact graph may already exist in apprenticeship and organizational-learning research.

foundational_upside.reason: Execution standards can alter the constituency capable of revising those standards.
foundational_upside.main_uncertainty: Existing legal/STS theories may already contain the same self-validation structure.

foundational_upside.reason: Provider competition may finance a separate concentration of rule-setting infrastructure.
foundational_upside.main_uncertainty: Need an essential financing return, not a renamed platform/network-effect story.

foundational_upside.reason: Delegation changes the social production of its own population-level revoker.
foundational_upside.main_uncertainty: Joint capacity and endogenous budget dynamics may be an already known collective-action model.

technical_upside.reason: A matched-quality fixed-budget model can separate local calibration from comparative knowledge.
technical_upside.main_uncertainty: Risk-sensitive exploitation and insufficient exploration may explain the full result already.

technical_upside.reason: A transfer test can expose equal action histories with different negative-rule and causal identifiability.
technical_upside.main_uncertainty: Ordinary full-rationale logs or generic identification methods may eliminate any residue.

technical_upside.reason: A queue/obligation model can distinguish instant halt from time to recognized collective release.
technical_upside.main_uncertainty: Ordinary burst queues and distributed cancellation may already predict everything.

technical_upside.reason: End-to-end validity can be tested separately from each bilateral adapter's success.
technical_upside.main_uncertainty: Distributed transactions and scheduling theory are strong potential antecedents.

technical_upside.reason: Provider-private causal precision and user comparative coverage can be independently measured.
technical_upside.main_uncertainty: Existing information economics may already model this exact acquisition asymmetry.

weird_low_confidence_high_regret.reason: Sincere authorship can reinforce an externally narrowed creative future.
weird_low_confidence_high_regret.main_uncertainty: Audience adaptation and genuine identity formation may dominate or make the effect beneficial.

weird_low_confidence_high_regret.reason: Temporal representation may be distorted by the very modification current sincere testimony evaluates.
weird_low_confidence_high_regret.main_uncertainty: Possible artificial interests and the right representation unit remain unresolved.

weird_low_confidence_high_regret.reason: Administrative identity units can produce the evidence later offered for their adequacy.
weird_low_confidence_high_regret.main_uncertainty: Requires genuine relevant divergence and selection, not superficial instance differences.

weird_low_confidence_high_regret.reason: Artificial relationship transitions may create independent civic capacity rather than only dependency.
weird_low_confidence_high_regret.main_uncertainty: The skills must transfer and participation must remain voluntary and sustainable.

weird_low_confidence_high_regret.reason: A technical boundary can become a normative source through recurrent public interpretation.
weird_low_confidence_high_regret.main_uncertainty: The audience inference and reinforcing default change are culturally contingent and may simply not occur.
